name: Hand AR Interfaces
summary:
Hand AR Interfaces puts the interface where your hands already are.

Not a panel floating in the room, and not a menu you reach for, eleven
instruments drawn directly onto the palm, wrist, forearm, knuckles and
fingertips, in passthrough, in your actual space. You look at your hand and the controls are on it.

ELEVEN INTERFACES

01  PALM KEYPAD     Twelve keys on your palm, readout at the wrist.
02  WRIST DIAL      An arc of channels on the back of your wrist.
